workOrder.note: Built in code from the call evidence. Verify parts on site before pickup.

steps.step: On arrival, confirm the leak location under the sink and under the cabinets, as the caller described.
Before touching anything, visually inspect the sink, faucet, and cabinet area for defects, corrosion, and water near anything electrical.
Re-check lighting and look for exposed wiring, scorch, melting, or open flame before reaching in.
Inspect the black hose connector the caller pointed to; note that no water was seen at it on the call.
Check the outlined supply line as the likely worn part, but verify its size and connections on site first.
Find the supply line, coupling nut, compression ring, and shutoff valve, and confirm the shutoff works before loosening anything.
Have ready two braided supply lines, 3/8 inch compression, plus tools to remove and fit coupling nuts.

gaps: Water was not actually seen on the call, so the exact drip point is unconfirmed
Where water appears under the sink and under the cabinet was not visible on video
The supply line identification was only a tentative outline, and the worn-part finding is only a hypothesis
Shutoff valve location and whether it works are unknown
